- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is unlikely that traditional banks will be completely replaced by fintech startups due to advantages like a large customer base, established infrastructure, regulatory expertise, and a wide range of products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Traditional banks may change their roles over time by adopting fintech solutions and collaborating with startups.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fintech startups employ various security measures including:

  - AI and machine learning to detect and prevent fraud.
  - Regular security audits and penetration testing.
  - Adherence to strict regulatory guidelines for data security.
